scriptName: 03 盾形对白 · 共享样式 v0.6 · 双作品 20261106
replaceString:
<pre hidden><style>/* rkd-dialogue-style:v0.6 */
[data-rkd="bubble"]{box-sizing:border-box;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:12px;margin:18px 0;max-width:100%;color:inherit;font:inherit;line-height:1.75;isolation:isolate}
[data-rkd="bubble"] [data-rkd-avatar]{position:relative;display:block;flex:0 0 54px;width:54px;height:76px;background:#f1ede4;border:1px solid #9d8c6b;border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden}
[data-rkd="bubble"] [data-rkd-avatar]::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:13px 9px;background:#d7cdb8;clip-path:polygon(0 0,100% 0,100% 60%,50% 100%,0 60%)}
[data-rkd="bubble"] [data-rkd-avatar]::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:3px;background-image:var(--rkd-image);background-position:center;background-size:contain;background-repeat:no-repeat}
[data-rkd="bubble"] [data-rkd-body]{min-width:0;flex:1 1 auto;padding-top:1px}
[data-rkd="bubble"] [data-rkd-speaker]{display:block;margin:0 0 5px 2px;font-size:.78em;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.07em;line-height:1.4;overflow-wrap:anywhere;color:inherit;opacity:.78}
[data-rkd="bubble"] [data-rkd-line]{position:relative;box-sizing:border-box;display:inline-block;max-width:100%;padding:10px 15px;border:1px solid #9d8c6b;border-left:3px solid #b6a071;border-radius:2px 12px 12px 12px;background:var(--SmartThemeBlurTintColor,rgba(30,32,39,.92));color:var(--SmartThemeBodyColor,#e9e6e0);white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere;word-break:normal;text-align:start;line-height:1.8}
[data-rkd="bubble"] [data-rkd-line]>p{margin:0}
@media(max-width:480px){[data-rkd="bubble"]{gap:9px;margin:15px 0}[data-rkd="bubble"] [data-rkd-avatar]{flex-basis:43px;width:43px;height:61px}[data-rkd="bubble"] [data-rkd-line]{padding:8px 11px}}
/* NPC 的作品标记由姓名正则给出；玩家标记由该消息的 MVU 给出。终端换皮不参与。 */
[data-rkd="bubble"]:is([data-rkd-asterisk]:not([data-rkd-asterisk=""]),[data-rkd-world="asterisk"]) [data-rkd-avatar]{height:62px;border:0;border-radius:0;background:#80d5e7;clip-path:polygon(50% 0,100% 25%,100% 75%,50% 100%,0 75%,0 25%)}
[data-rkd="bubble"]:is([data-rkd-asterisk]:not([data-rkd-asterisk=""]),[data-rkd-world="asterisk"]) [data-rkd-avatar]::before{inset:2px;background:#173b50;clip-path:polygon(50% 0,100% 25%,100% 75%,50% 100%,0 75%,0 25%)}
[data-rkd="bubble"][data-rkd-asterisk]:not([data-rkd-asterisk=""]) [data-rkd-avatar]::after{content:var(--rkd-initial,"");inset:auto;top:var(--rkd-portrait-top,0);left:var(--rkd-portrait-left,0);width:var(--rkd-portrait-width,100%);height:var(--rkd-portrait-height,100%);display:grid;place-items:center;color:#d4f6ff;font-size:1.2em;background-size:100% auto;background-position:0 0}
[data-rkd="bubble"]:is([data-rkd-asterisk]:not([data-rkd-asterisk=""]),[data-rkd-world="asterisk"]) [data-rkd-line]{border:1px solid #6497ab;border-left:3px solid #86d2e5;border-radius:2px 10px 2px 10px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#203f53,#112d42);color:#dbedf5}
@media(max-width:480px){[data-rkd="bubble"]:is([data-rkd-asterisk]:not([data-rkd-asterisk=""]),[data-rkd-world="asterisk"]) [data-rkd-avatar]{height:50px}}
